summary: Timeboxed delivery of sampled, KMS-encrypted inference request slices to external auditor for privacy attestation
description:
Issue summary: External auditor engagement (PrivacyFirm Inc.) requires a verifiable sample of inference requests and associated minimal metadata for a regulatory attestation. The sample must be timeboxed, delivered off-platform to an auditor under a strict access model, and encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.

Impact: Audit cannot proceed until the sample is delivered. This blocks the Privacy & Compliance team's deadline for certificate issuance. The sample contains user prompts and non-sensitive system metadata; we must minimize PII exposure and record audit trail for all access.

Environment: Production inference logging stored in s3://redwood-prod-inference-traces (us-east-1), with cross-region replicate to eu-west-1. Exports must obey data minimization policy and require engineering + security authorization.

Requested deliverable: A 1,000-record random sample (stratified by model family and region) of request/response pairs from 2026-02-15 to 2026-02-21, with PII redaction applied, packaged in a single KMS-encrypted tarball, and a reproducible audit manifest (hashes, sampling seed, query filters). Access window: 72 hours for PrivacyFirm.

Acceptance criteria: (1) Redaction applied per internal rules (remove emails, credit-card-patterns, long free-text user PII); (2) Artifact encrypted with customer-managed KMS key alias arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-...; (3) Delivery uses pre-signed S3 URL scoped to auditor IAM role and expires after 72 hours; (4) Audit trail logged (CloudTrail + internal access log entry); (5) Notification and attestation record added to Confluence page.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - data extraction / access workflow request. Steps to produce similar export: 1) Create sampling query against prod-inference-archive partitioned by date/model. 2) Run redaction script (internal/redact/py) in airflow isolated worker. 3) Bundle and encrypt with KMS CMK. 4) Create time-limited presigned URL bound to external IAM role. 5) Record audit events and notify compliance.
logs_summary: Preliminary log scan performed: ~1.2M requests present in date range across models. Candidate sample set created using deterministic RNG seed=112358. Initial redaction pass flagged ~3.4% of samples requiring secondary manual review (long pasted blobs containing base64 attachments). No encryption or KMS errors encountered during dry-run. CloudTrail shows prior admin grants to audit-role were not present and must be created for delivery.
investigation_notes:
1) Hypothesis: We can fulfill request using existing export tooling (airflow job export_inference_sample) with minor tweaks for KMS CMK usage and presigned URL bound to external IAM principal.
2) Constraint: External auditor cannot assume role in our account by default; security prefers to provide presigned S3 URL and not cross-account role assumptions for external vendors.
3) Redaction complexity: Large inline attachments and embedded keys found in ~40 records; these require manual masking or removal. Proposed approach: remove offending records from delivered sample and note in manifest to preserve sampling reproducibility, then substitute with next-in-sequence record using same seed.
4) Compliance sign-off required: Legal and Security must approve the manifest and KMS CMK before release.
5) Temporary IAM policy needs to be created granting GetObject on specific S3 key path and to restrict by ip-range (auditor vpn), and expiration is automated through terraform apply-and-destroy workflow.

resolution: In progress. Plan agreed: produce stratified sample, drop 34 problematic records and substitute deterministically, encrypt artifact with CMK alias/rdw-audit-2026, deliver via presigned S3 URL valid 72 hours, and log access events. Security and Legal to sign off on manifest before share. Post-delivery tasks: (1) automate this flow into a guarded runbook, (2) add an audit-only IAM path with one-time token provisioning. Follow-up task created INT-951002 to implement automation and telemetry for future auditors.
